Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' Crosses ₹800 Crore Worldwide

The Rajinikanth-starrer film 'Jailer 2' has surpassed ₹800 crore in worldwide box office collection. As of Day 18, the film's gross collection reached ₹807.25 crore.
